name: Grilled Pork Chop with German-Style Potato Salad & Pickled Veggies

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg new potatoes
3 medium carrots
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
3 Granny Smith apples

instructions.primary_message: Quarter potatoes; place in a large pot, along with salt, and cover with hot water (from the tap). Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer until fork-tender, 10-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, place vinegar, sugar, dill, and salt in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the pickling liquid.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup apple cider vinegar
2 tbsp brown sugar
¾ tsp dill, dried
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and halve carrots lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons; add to the bowl with the pickling liquid.
Trim and halve cucumbers lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons; add to the bowl, stir to combine, and set aside.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a large bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the parsley along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp apple cider vinegar
2 tbsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 pork chops, boneless
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil; working in batches if necessary, add pork chops and grill until golden and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and let rest, 5 minutes.
When the potatoes are done, drain and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, halve, and slice shallots into thin half-moons; add to the bowl.
Quarter, core, and small dice apples; add to the bowl and stir to combine the potato salad.
To serve, divide pork chops, potato salad, and pickled veggies between plates. Enjoy!
